chunks: When those who were followed will disclaim those who followed them, and see the torment, all ties between them shall be severed,
ai.seo_question: What happens between followers and leaders on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the ultimate failure of blind imitation (taqlid) when the truth becomes undeniable, illustrating how followers will disown their leaders or idols upon witnessing the punishment. The severing of 'connections' (al-asbab) signifies the complete collapse of all worldly and spiritual ties that once bound them, leaving each soul accountable for its own choices.
